sentences.text: The FIR unfolds that the petitioner had a love relationship with the informant.
On 29.11.2023, the petitioner took the informant with false promises of marriage.
Thereafter, the petitioner started to subject the informant to cruelty and after 1 months, the petitioner drove out the informant from his house.
5. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that no case under Sections 420/344/366 of the IPC is made out.
6. It is submitted that, the victim on her own volition went to the petitioner's house and she was staying with him.

7. As per customary rites, a community meeting was held and a date was fixed for marriage,
Annexure-2 is the minutes of the meeting with signature of the members present in the meeting,
and Annexure-3 is the marriage invitation card as a date for marriage was fixed on 01.03.2024, as per discussions held on 21.11.2023.
8.

It is further submitted that no case under section 420 of the IPC has been made out against the petitioner as there is no instance of cheating and the petitioner is willing to marry the informant, but the informant is not willing to marry the petitioner and she has slammed a false case against the petitioner.
9.
I have considered the submissions at the bar with circumspection.
10. The petitioner has appeared before the Investigating Officer and has cooperated with the investigation.
The petitioner has not violated any bail conditions.
Hence, the interim order dated 12.06.2024 is hereby made absolute.
11. In the above terms, this Anticipatory Bail application stands disposed of.
Page No.# 3/3 12.
Send back the Case Diary.
